# unityrs

> unityrs is a Rust port of UnityPy 1.25.2 for exploring, reading and extracting Unity files. Agents and scripts can discover the CLI with describe, page through an inventory with inspect, read a bounded natural JSON value with show (or --value canonical for tags), and export assets with extract or the budgeted batch engine.

## Guides

- [README](README.md): Project overview and command-line examples.
- [Agent and script guide](docs/AGENTS.md): Versioned JSON, natural values and exact tags, limits, content-bound pagination and errors.
- [Batch specification](docs/BATCH_SPEC.md): Job schema, budgets, outputs, progress and exit codes.
- [Canonical dump](docs/CANONICAL_DUMP.md): Canonical value representation and parity records.
- [Design](docs/DESIGN.md): Architecture and crate responsibilities.
- [Python package](crates/unityrs-py/README.md): UnityPy-compatible in-process API.
